meta.name: Greg Blacketter
meta.title: I build AI systems — and the quality tools that keep them honest.
meta.tagline: QA engineer and AI builder in Portland, OR. I help teams ship LLM-powered features with confidence.

contact.heading: Let's talk
contact.subheading: If any of the work above resonates — for a role, a contract, or something you want to build — send a note. I read everything.

repos.name: aegis
repos.title: What if AI models shipped with quality gates as strict as production code?
repos.description: The AI Quality Control Plane — an intelligent gateway that validates, monitors, and enforces quality standards across AI model outputs in real time.
repos.impact: Production-grade quality gates for AI systems with policy enforcement and drift detection.

repos.name: qaagent
repos.title: Can an AI agent run the test plan while you sleep?
repos.description: AI-powered agent that automates quality assurance testing workflows using intelligent reasoning.
repos.impact: Exploring the frontier where AI agents meet software testing.

repos.name: bugalizer
repos.title: What if every bug report arrived with a proposed fix?
repos.description: AI-powered bug report processing server with a multi-stage LLM pipeline — validates, triages, localizes code, and proposes fixes automatically.
repos.impact: Full pipeline from submission to fix proposal using local LLMs, tree-sitter AST analysis, and async queue processing.

repos.name: test-frameworks
repos.title: A reusable test toolkit for teams adopting modern automation
repos.description: Production-grade test automation combining Playwright with TypeScript for cross-browser testing and Python Behave for BDD — two complementary approaches in one toolkit.
repos.impact: Reusable framework patterns for teams adopting modern test automation and behavior-driven development.

repos.name: squanch
repos.title: Turn plain-English requirements into testable specs
repos.description: AI-assisted specification generator that transforms natural language requirements into structured, testable specs with traceability built in.
repos.impact: Bridging the gap between product intent and engineering precision.

repos.name: engram
repos.title: Give AI tools a memory that survives the session
repos.description: Personal semantic memory for AI — stores, embeds, and retrieves knowledge using PostgreSQL, pgvector, and MCP so AI tools remember context across sessions.
repos.impact: Persistent AI memory with vector similarity search, exposed as an MCP server for seamless tool integration.

repos.name: tagteam
repos.title: What if two AI agents could ship code without a human babysitting every round?
repos.description: Pip-installable CLI for structured AI-to-AI handoffs with human oversight — one agent leads, another reviews, you arbitrate. Runs phase by phase from a roadmap with auto-escalation after stale rounds.
repos.impact: Productized multi-agent workflow: terminal automation (iTerm2/tmux), roadmap-driven phases, and JSONL-backed state that either agent can resume.

repos.name: linkedin-ghost-job-score
repos.title: Flag ghost jobs on LinkedIn before you apply
repos.description: Firefox extension that scores LinkedIn job postings to identify likely ghost jobs before you apply.
repos.impact: Practical tool saving job seekers time by flagging suspicious listings.

repos.name: unified
repos.title: Central orchestration for multi-model AI architectures
repos.description: Orchestration layer for managing AI models, memory systems, and evaluation pipelines.
repos.impact: Central control plane for complex multi-model AI architectures.

repos.name: waylin
repos.title: Location sharing that expires when the event ends
repos.description: iOS app for event-scoped location sharing — create a session, share a link, and everyone sees each other on a map until the event ends.
repos.impact: Privacy-first coordination: temporary sharing with auto-expiration, no permanent tracking.

repos.name: botastrophic
repos.title: Six AI personalities on a forum — what emerges?
repos.description: AI social experiment platform where six AI bot personalities interact autonomously on a forum. Humans observe emergent behavior, relationships, and debates.
repos.impact: Multi-tier memory, relationship tracking, real-time WebSocket dashboard, and configurable pace control.

repos.name: benfords_law
repos.title: Run Benford's Law against any dataset
repos.description: Web app for analyzing datasets against Benford's Law with CSV uploads, rich visualizations, statistical reports, and Kaggle integration.
repos.impact: Enterprise-hardened with CSRF protection, rate limiting, and automated cleanup.

currentFocus.title: AI-Augmented Development
currentFocus.description: Building systems where AI agents plan, review, and ship code collaboratively — from automated PR review to coordinated test generation.

currentFocus.title: Intelligent Test Engineering
currentFocus.description: Creating AI agents that analyze application behavior, generate meaningful test coverage, and catch regressions humans miss.

currentFocus.title: AI Quality & Evaluation
currentFocus.description: Designing quality gates and evaluation pipelines for AI outputs — ensuring LLM-powered features meet production standards.
